text:
Alex: Hey team, PR #4123 (feature/stream-index) is red on CI after the merge to main, blocking other merges. Failing tests: `integration/kv/kv_client_test` and `authz/role_mapping_test`. CI link: https://ci.redwood/runs/98765 :grimacing:
Maria: ugh ok. I see `kv_client_test` failing with timeouts in the `prefetch` stage. paste of the failing lines:
```
=== FAIL: integration/kv/kv_client_test (12.34s)
    kv_client_test.go:142: expected heartbeat within 5s, got 12s
```
Sam: was that from your branch or main? Alex: from main after merging feature/stream-index (I rebased earlier but there were some hunks).
CI-bot: build 98765: FAIL (tests: integration/kv/kv_client_test, authz/role_mapping_test) | trigger: merge/main@feature/stream-index
Kyle: I can take a look and try a local reproduce. Any tips to reproduce quickly? docker-compose or just `make test-integration`?
Maria: `make test-integration` with `KV_PREFETCH=false` used to help isolate but default should pass. The timeout looks like a flake that surfaces under slower CI nodes.
Olivia: Also check `golden` diffs for authz test — I saw a snapshot mismatch earlier in a different run. Could be ordering nondeterminism.
Jenna: If this is blocking other PRs, we could temporarily disable that test with a flaky skip and revert later? Not great but buys time. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sam: prefer root cause. Can we rerun the CI shard first? Alex: I kicked a rebuild for job 98765 (re-run #1).
CI-bot: rebuild 98765: queued -> running -> PASSED on kv_client_test, FAILED on authz/role_mapping_test (same stack)
Olivia: authz failure stack shows `role_list` ordering diff, looks like map iteration ordering leak. I pushed a quick patch to stable branch to sort before compare: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/3a7c5f
Alex: did that patch get backported to the feature branch? I didn't include it in my rebase.
Kyle: I can rebase feature/stream-index on top of stable with that commit, push a branch and request a CI run. Need approval to force-push to feature branch? Alex: go ahead, it's my branch.
Sam: before force-push, can you run a local `go test -run TestRoleMapping -count=50 ./...` to be confident?
Kyle: running now, will report.
(about 4m later)
Kyle: local 50 runs ✅ all passed. Going to rebase and push, then trigger CI.
CI-bot: new build 98788 triggered by Kyle on feature/stream-index (rebase + sort-fix)
CI-bot: build 98788: running -> PASSED (integration/kv/kv_client_test) -> PASSED (authz/role_mapping_test) :tada:
Alex: awesome, thanks Kyle and Olivia for the quick fix.
Jenna: can we add a tiny test that asserts deterministic ordering in that code path so future changes catch this early?
Maria: +1. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR against main with the deterministic compare test.
Sam: and maybe add that golden check into the nightly long-run to catch flakes caused by slow nodes.
Alex: agreed. For now I'm unblocking the merge queue. I'll merge feature/stream-index after CI green. Thanks everyone. :pray:
